[
    inet:ipv4=1.1.1.1
    inet:fqdn=example.com
    +#test.tag
]

/*

    Alienvault OTX whois records are fucking weird. There can be multiple
    dates with no context. E.g.: multiple creation dates, expiration dates.

    https://otx.alienvault.com/indicator/domain/bbc-news.org

    Using other vendor data going to take the earlier date in the whois
    results
*/

Dependencies:
    -- Crowdstrike API key.
    -- No nodes should be inbound when calling this snippet due to the use of for loops.
*/

// Iterate over each yielded result.

$validin = $lib.import(s1.validin)


divert $cmdopts.yield $validin.dns($node, $cmdopts)

$download = $lib.import(s1.validin.download)


divert $cmdopts.yield $download.download($node)

$validin = $lib.import(s1.validin)


divert $cmdopts.yield $validin.whois($node, $cmdopts)

/*
Set the TLPBlack keys (global only)
*/

$admin = $lib.import(s1.tlpblack.privsep.admin)
$admin.set_global_apikey($cmdopts.apikey)
$admin.set_global_username($cmdopts.username)
$admin.set_global_password($cmdopts.password)

/*
Utility functions for S1 Threat Intelligence Notifier.

Provides helper functions for tag filtering, URL building, and data processing.
*/

$actors = $lib.import(s1.gti.actors)


divert $cmdopts.yield $actors.threat_actors(
    iocs=$cmdopts.iocs,
    malware=$cmdopts.malware,
    since=$cmdopts.since,
    since_last=$cmdopts.since_last
)

$campaigns = $lib.import(s1.gti.campaigns)


divert $cmdopts.yield $campaigns.campaigns(
    iocs=$cmdopts.iocs,
    since=$cmdopts.since,
    since_last=$cmdopts.since_last,
)

$enrich = $lib.import(s1.gti.enrich)


divert $cmdopts.yield $enrich.enrich($node)

$malware = $lib.import(s1.gti.malware)


divert $cmdopts.yield $malware.malware_families(
    iocs=$cmdopts.iocs,
    malware=$cmdopts.malware,
    since=$cmdopts.since,
    since_last=$cmdopts.since_last,
    yara=$cmdopts.yara
)

$reports = $lib.import(s1.gti.reports)


divert $cmdopts.yield $reports.reports(
    iocs=$cmdopts.iocs,
    since=$cmdopts.since,
    since_last=$cmdopts.since_last,
    yara=$cmdopts.yara
)
